t: A small sound-processing board for building your own synths and effects.
steps: Buy a Core board from a synth DIY shop such as Thonk, Alt Circuits or SchneidersLaden.
Pick a kit such as Gills, or plan your own jacks, knobs, and buttons.
Solder the pin headers and wire in audio jacks.
Download and install the free Ksoloti Patcher on your computer.
Connect the board over USB-C with a good 5 volt supply.
Open a simple oscillator example patch and upload it to the board.
Plug in headphones and turn a knob to hear the sound change.
meta: Open Board. From $58. A few stores.
